judges.isba_evaluation: Judge Walsh was elected in 2020. Prior to her election, Judge Walsh worked for a firm handling defending insureds from State Farm from pleadings through trial. Those familiar with Judge Walsh’s conduct on the bench were uniformly positive about her legal knowledge, sensitivity, temperament, diligence, and character.

He is currently assigned as a supervising judge in the Criminal Division at the Leighton Criminal Courthouse. Judge Watkins was universally praised for his legal knowledge, diligence, professionalism and temperament. He treats everyone appearing before him with respect and is fair to both sides. He is noted as being prepared, punctual, and ‘a student of the law’.
